title: Finance Assistant (with Payroll)
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
As a Finance Assistant in Edinburgh, you'll support the day-to-day accounting and financial tasks that keep the business running smoothly. This role in the business services industry is all about ensuring accurate records, assisting with reports, and being a reliable part of the finance team.

Client Details

This company operates in the business services industry and is based in Edinburgh.

Description
- Maintain and update financial records with accuracy and attention to detail.
- Assist in preparing financial reports and ensuring they meet deadlines.
- Support the reconciliation of accounts, including bank statements and ledgers.
- Process invoices, expenses, and payments efficiently.
- Collaborate with the finance team to ensure compliance with financial policies.
- Respond to internal and external financial queries promptly.
- Help with month-end and year-end financial processes.
- Provide general administrative support to the accounting and finance department.

Profile

A successful Finance Assistant should have:
- A background in accounting or finance, with relevant qualifications or training.
- We are ideally looking for payroll experience
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Experience using accounting software and tools.
- Good communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- An understanding of financial processes and reporting requirements.

Job Offer
- A permanent contract within the business services industry.
- A salary range of £33,000 - £35,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- The opportunity to work in Aberdeen

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
FindCore are thrilled to be assisting an established heavy lifting equipment business with the recruitment of a Logistics Coordinator.

Permanent, full-time position based in Aberdeen. This company has a fantastic reputation

Salary

Competitive, depending on experience + additional benefits + growth opportunities

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate the movement of lifting equipment and associated components to and from sites.
- Plan logistics schedules with operations teams, site supervisors and transport providers.
- Manage transport documentation including permits, route plans and lifting schedules.
- Monitor and track crane movements using logistics and GPS systems.
- Maintain accurate records of equipment usage, delivery times and maintenance schedules.
- Respond to logistics issues, delays and changing site requirements.
- Support procurement and inventory management for crane parts and accessories.
- Coordinate with maintenance teams to ensure equipment is ready and available.
- Ensure transport activity complies with health & safety requirements, road regulations and load restrictions.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience within logistics, transport coordination or a similar role.
- Experience within cranes, heavy lifting, construction or heavy equipment would be highly advantageous.
- Good understanding of transport planning and regulations.
- Strong organisation and scheduling skills.
- Confident working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
- Good communication and problem-solving ability.

What's on Offer
- Permanent, full-time position.
- Opportunity to join an established business with a fantastic reputation
- Varied logistics role supporting complex equipment movements.
- Long-term development opportunities.
- Competitive additional benefits.

Please apply.

title: Private Client Paralegal
description:
Private Client Paralegal - Inverness

A great opportunity for a Private Client Paralegal to join an established Inverness firm advising individuals and families on a range of legal matters.

What's on offer?
- Varied private client workload
- Supportive team environment
- Ongoing training and development

The role
- Draft wills and powers of attorney
- Assist with executry and estate administration
- Support guardianship applications and related matters
- Prepare legal documents and correspondence
- Liaise with clients, courts and third parties
- Manage files and key deadlines

About you
- Previous private client experience
- Knowledge of wills, executries, powers of attorney and guardianships
- Excellent client care and communication skills
- Organised and able to manage a varied workload
- Proactive and team-focused approach

The environment

You'll be joining a friendly and experienced team that provides practical and compassionate advice to clients across the Highlands, with genuine opportunities for long-term development.

If you're a Private Client Paralegal considering your next move, we would welcome a confidential chat.

How to Apply:
- Online: Apply with your updated CV via the provided link
- Contact: For immediate consideration, contact Becky Newton at G2 Legal

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
The Company

Able Bridge Recruitment are currently working in partnership with a top 15 accountancy firm in the recruitment of a bookkeeper who will be based in the Inverness office.

Benefits include

Enhanced holiday entitlement

Private medical insurance

Life insurance x 4

Income protection

Pension which is up to 10% contributory

Flexi working & hybrid working

This vacancy, the result of growth will report into the one of the firm's partners and will be office based for at least 3 days per week.

The Responsibilities

The purpose of this role is to provide a wide portfolio of clients with bookkeeping services. The role will cover a multitude of industry sectors and will provide a varied and rewarding role for an experienced practice bookkeeper.

On a day-to-day basis you can expect to be responsible for the following;

Process accounts payable and receivable for a portfolio of clients

Complete bank reconciliations with accuracy and efficiency

Preparing and submitting VAT returns

Setting up client software for clients wishing to undertake their own bookkeeping

Providing helpful training to clients on using Xero & SAGE

The Requirements

We are seeking a well versed bookkeeper (minimum of 3 years), of experience managing a portfolio of clients from within the UK. We are looking for applicants to be strong communicators in both written and verbal form and are seeking strong IT skills including Xero or Sage as well as MS office packages. This is an ideal opportunity for a locally based candidate (Inverness), to join an established and growing accountancy practice.

Our client does not hold a license to offer study support so will only consider applicants who are able to work unrestricted within the UK and who are based in the immediate vicinity.

If you are interested in hearing more detail about this role or would like to have a confidential chat about a potential career move, please do not hesitate in contacting Joe Savidge.
